entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.05 +/- 0.05 solar radii from Hellier et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-96 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014MNRAS.440.1982H/abstract). entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,540 K and log g 4.42 (u1 0.511, u2 0.226): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
